title.zh: 将新怡诗夏省 San Jose 市 Caanawan 描笼涯的Constancio Padilla国立中学的Caanawan附属校分离，改设为独立的同名国立中学，并为此拨付所需经费
title.en: An Act Separating the Constancio Padilla National High School-Caanawan Annex in Barangay Caanawan, City of San Jose, Province of Nueva Ecija From the Constancio Padilla National High School, Converting It Into An Independent National High School to Be Known as Caanawan National High School and Appropriating Funds Therefor
title.orig: An Act Separating the Constancio Padilla National High School-Caanawan Annex in Barangay Caanawan, City of San Jose, Province of Nueva Ecija From the Constancio Padilla National High School, Converting It Into An Independent National High School to Be Known as Caanawan National High School and Appropriating Funds Therefor
title.vi: Đạo luật tách Phân hiệu Caanawan của Trường Trung học Constancio Padilla Quốc gia tại Barangay Caanawan, Thành phố San Jose, Tỉnh Nueva Ecija khỏi Trường Trung học Constancio Padilla Quốc gia và chuyển thành Trường Trung học Độc lập Quốc gia với tên gọi Trường Trung học Caanawan Quốc gia, và bố trí kinh phí
title.th: พระราชบัญญัติแยกวิทยาเขต Caanawan ของโรงเรียนมัธยมศึกษา Constancio Padilla แห่งชาติในบารังไกย์ Caanawan เมือง San Jose จังหวัด Nueva Ecija ออกจากโรงเรียนมัธยมศึกษา Constancio Padilla แห่งชาติและยกฐานะเป็นโรงเรียนมัธยมศึกษาเอกเทศแห่งชาติชื่อโรงเรียนมัธยมศึกษา Caanawan แห่งชาติ และจัดสรรงบประมาณ
title.id: Undang-Undang Memisahkan Kampus Caanawan, Sekolah Menengah Constancio Padilla Nasional di Barangay Caanawan, Kota San Jose, Provinsi Nueva Ecija dari Sekolah Menengah Constancio Padilla Nasional dan menjadi Sekolah Menengah Mandiri Nasional dengan nama Sekolah Menengah Caanawan Nasional, dan mengalokasikan dana
title.ms: Akta Memisahkan Kampus Caanawan, Sekolah Menengah Constancio Padilla Kebangsaan di Barangay Caanawan, Bandar San Jose, Wilayah Nueva Ecija daripada Sekolah Menengah Constancio Padilla Kebangsaan dan menjadi Sekolah Menengah Bebas Kebangsaan dengan nama Sekolah Menengah Caanawan Kebangsaan, dan memperuntukkan dana

text.en: Separation and Conversion into a National High School. - The Constancio Padilla National High School Caanawan Annex in Barangay Caanawan, City of San Jose, Province of Nueva Ecij a is hereby separated from the Constancio Padilla National High School and converted into an independent national high school to be known as Caanawan National High School.

Transfer of Assets and Liabilities. - All personnel, assets, liabilities and records of the Constancio Padilla National High Schoo1- Caanawan Annex are hereby transferred to and absorbed by the Caanawan National High School.

Appropriations. - The Secretary of Education shall immediately include in the Department's program the operationalization ofthe Caanawan National High School, the initial funding of which shall be charged against the current year's appropriations of the Constancio Padilla National High School Caanawan Annex. Thereafter, the amount necessary for tile continued operation ofthe school shall be included in the annual General Appropriations Act.
Implementation. - The Secretary of Education shall issue such rules and regulations as may be necessary to carry out -the purpose of this Act.
Effectivity. - This Act shall take effect fifteen (15) days after its plication in the Official Gazette.
